name: The Home Counties
description: A single-player extraction shooter set in a collapsed, overgrown Britain. Raid Duncombe Street in Bletchley, loot what's left, and reach the red smoke before the timer runs out.
tagline: Raid the overgrown terraces, take what you can carry, and reach the red smoke before the clock runs out...

cta.heading: Early days
cta.text: The Home Counties is in early development. New builds, maps and weapons are written up in the dev log as they're added.

features.title: A real street
features.text: Duncombe Street in Bletchley, laid out from real map data: Victorian terraces beside the West Coast Main Line, the old Sainsbury's and its car park.

features.title: Loot and extract
features.text: Twelve-minute raids, with multiple loot spots, enterable houses and scav bodies to search. Extract before the timer ends, or lose what you were carrying.

features.title: Scav AI
features.text: Scavs are armed. They take cover, flank in pairs, and come to investigate when they hear you.

features.title: Noise
features.text: Sprinting, gunfire and moving through long grass all make noise. Walking, crouching and leaning round corners keep you quieter.

features.title: Gear and weight
features.text: Helmet, armour, rig, backpack, weapon slots and four pockets. The more you carry, the slower you move and the faster your stamina drains.

features.title: Overgrown
features.text: Lots of trees and hedges for cover, knee-high grass, wrecked cars and boarded-up houses. The streets are abandoned and overgrown.

loop.title: Gear up
loop.text: Choose a loadout. Anything you take in can be lost.

loop.title: Deploy
loop.text: You start at the west or east end of Water Eaton Road, picked at random.

loop.title: Loot
loop.text: Search crates, houses and dead scavs. Keep an eye on your carry weight.

loop.title: Extract
loop.text: Reach an exit marked by red smoke and stay in the green zone for ten seconds. If you die, you lose everything you were carrying.
